title: Publish the ROM coverage map on GitHub Pages
changes: Enabled GitHub Pages from the public decomp branch /docs folder and linked the existing metadata-only EUR coverage map.
Documented that report regeneration happens locally and the committed snapshot is republished after a push.
validation: GitHub Pages built commit 32caaab0; public HTML and JSON returned HTTP 200 with SHA-256 matching the committed report.
Chrome rendered the e170-d169 snapshot and an offset search selected the expected 64 KiB range.
limitations: The published report is an EUR snapshot generated on 2026-11-18; it does not measure matching or completed decompilation by function.
Report regeneration is a local manual step; Pages only republishes committed files. The site root has no landing page.
